description: Reduce resident project instructions and use approved analysis tools
changelog: Shorten the native AGENTS block while preserving startup/resume, workflow and Task CLI ownership, spec navigation and no-hook fallback. Remove default GitNexus recommendations and installation recipes from spec bootstrapping; use approved available analysis tools or current source and tests.
notes: Update CLI, Core and the optional Paseo adapter together. Refresh initialized projects with native trellis update and review modified-file conflicts individually. Preserve manual text, other instruction owners and local configuration. This release does not remove unmanaged third-party instructions, install analysis tools or create indexes; project-specific retirement requires separate explicit authorization.
